run_detection_on_images: run object detection on input images using Detectron2 with a config file and confidence threshold
run_detection_on_webcam: run real-time object detection on webcam feed using Detectron2 VisualizationDemo
run_detection_on_video: run object detection on a video file and optionally save the annotated output video
setup_detectron2_config: setup a Detectron2 config from a YAML file with command-line overrides and confidence threshold
test_opencv_video_format: test whether a given OpenCV video codec and file extension are supported on the system
